rejectDuplicateObjectKeys.note: Parsers that silently collapse duplicate keys are insufficient for direct raw JSON verification.

floats.representation: canonical vectors define the required serialization

steps.name: Reject duplicate JSON object keys
steps.rule: Duplicate object keys MUST be rejected before ordinary JSON parsing can collapse them.

steps.name: Canonicalize null and undefined as null
steps.rule: null and undefined values canonicalize to the JSON token null.

steps.name: Reject unsupported primitive types
steps.rule: BigInt and Symbol values are rejected.

steps.name: Reject unsafe integers
steps.rule: Integers outside the IEEE-754 safe integer range are rejected.

steps.name: Serialize finite floats deterministically
steps.rule: Finite non-integer numbers serialize according to the canonical vectors.

steps.name: Sort object keys
steps.rule: Object keys are sorted lexicographically by UTF-16 code-unit comparison.

steps.name: Exclude undefined object values
steps.rule: Object properties whose value is undefined are omitted.

steps.name: Preserve array order
steps.rule: Array element order is preserved exactly.

steps.name: Serialize without insignificant whitespace
steps.rule: Canonical JSON contains no insignificant whitespace.

steps.name: Preserve Unicode code points
steps.rule: No Unicode normalization is applied during canonicalization.

steps.name: Enforce canonicalization depth
steps.rule: Nesting depth greater than 128 is rejected.
